Carmen: Heads up — I'm about to land a small TF change that moves the secret owner annotation from `infra.redwood/owner` -> `secret.owner.redwood`. Trying to standardize naming, but this will flip ownership logic for ExternalSecrets reconciliation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4892 Can folks eyeball for obvious fallout? Particularly rotation hooks and SA bindings.

devops-bot: CI: terraform plan succeeded, apply blocked pending approvals. :white_check_mark:

Ryan: which namespaces/services will be impacted? Any critical prod ones?

Carmen: payments, model-serving, telemetry-ingest are the main ones. payments has manual rotation hooks; model-serving uses CSI mounts and the watcher looks for `infra.redwood/owner` today.

Samir: Quick note — ExternalSecrets matching is annotation-driven, so if we rename it the ES CRs will stop matching until we update them. Proposed safe plan:
1) patch ExternalSecrets controller + helm values to accept both keys (prefer new)
2) apply a namespaced job that copies old annotation -> new for resources (dry-run first)
3) roll controller change and remove fallback after 48h
Also double-check Vault path templates that interpolate `{{annotation "infra.redwood/owner"}}`.

Leo: For payments I'd avoid any window of "no owner". Keep both annotations for 48h. Controller fallback snippet suggestion:

```
extraEnv:
  - name: OWNER_ANNOTATION
    value: "secret.owner.redwood,infra.redwood/owner"
```

This lets controller prefer the new key but accept the old while we migrate.

devops-bot: integration tests: model-serving fixture failing with mount permission denied on CSI sidecar. tagging @Ryan.

Ryan: @Samir can you run the migration job in staging and coordinate with payments oncall? I'll take model-serving ticket and look into CSI permissions.

Samir: on it. I'll prepare a k8s job that enumerates secrets and copies annotation -> newkey, with `--dry-run=client` first. ETA ~2hrs to run in staging and report.

Carmen: thanks — I'll hold the TF PR until you confirm migration success and the controller rollout plan. :thumbsup:

Leo: I'll add a checklist to the ops runbook: secrets-migration (prechecks, timeline, rollback steps, post-migration verification).

Ryan: if staging looks good I can approve the apply and coordinate a short maintenance window for payments. :eyes:

Carmen: sounds good. I'll ping here once the PR is blocked for apply and add the release note. Thanks everyone.
